paragraphs.text:
CAIRO MUSEUM  
The museum is open 9am to noon, and from 3pm-6pm daily. 
Three exhibits in this great museum might interest you: 
• For Treasures from the Pyramids, go to 290.
• For Tombs of the Ancients, go to 236.
• For the Karpathos Device, go to 209. 
• If you might want to interview the curator, Amet Keh, go 
to 302. 
Or, go to a Cairo location on the Egypt Location Table.
(Egypt Location)
